# Launch post drafts

Ground rules: be clear it is Windows-first, link the repo, answer every comment, never ask for stars.

## Show HN

**Title:** Show HN: Pocket Desk Agent – control your Windows PC from Telegram, no open ports

**Body:**
I wanted to reach my PC from my phone without TeamViewer accounts, port forwarding or a VPN. Pocket Desk Agent is a self-hosted Telegram bot that connects outbound only, so nothing is exposed.

- Screenshots, clipboard, hotkeys, window switching, sleep/shutdown, sandboxed file browsing.
- OCR click-by-text, macros, and tasks that survive restarts.
- A live remote desktop in the browser over a Cloudflare tunnel.
- Optional Gemini computer use with confirmation buttons for anything destructive.
- `pip install pocket-desk-agent`, then `pdagent` runs a setup wizard. MIT licensed.

Repo: https://github.com/techgniouss/pdagent
Windows is the main target; some features are partial on macOS/Linux (see the compatibility table in the README).
